steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
script="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci_plan.py"
jobs="lint tests doc msrv debian packages supply freshness folder lines"
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = pull_request ] && [ "$BASE_REF" = develop ] \
  && git show "$BASE_SHA:.github/scripts/ci_plan/ci_plan.py" > "$script" \
  && python3 -I "$script"; then
  # A job the planner of the base does not know yet runs: the change that
  # adds it is judged by the planner before it.
  for job in $jobs; do
    grep -q "^$job=" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || echo "$job=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  done
  exit 0
fi
echo "No trusted PR plan; running all work on $EVENT_NAME"
for job in $jobs; do
  value=true
  # The package checks take their tools from the repositories of other
  # distributions. The queue does not repeat them: the pull request that
  # changed the packaging ran them, and the promotion into main and the push
  # to main run them again over what the queue merged.
  if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = merge_group ] && [ "$job" = packages ]; then
    value=false
  fi
  # The nightly run exists to seed the cargo caches, which only the
  # Rust jobs use; the rest would be a second copy of the push to main.
  if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = schedule ]; then
    case "$job" in debian | packages | supply | folder | lines) value=false ;; esac
  fi
  echo "$job=$value" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
done
